categories.main_business_segments: TODA KOGYO operates two main business segments: Functional Pigments and Electronic Materials. The Functional Pigments segment focuses on the manufacture and sale of magnetic powder materials, various coloring materials, and catalysts, while the Electronic Materials segment covers ferrite compounds, ferrite materials, soft magnetic materials, dielectric materials, and lithium-ion battery (LIB) materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies are based on advanced fine particle synthesis, particularly iron oxide-based micro-particle synthesis, wet chemical synthesis, and composite material technologies. Production methods include wet synthesis for high-uniformity barium titanate, proprietary surface treatment for corrosion-resistant rare-earth magnets, and compounding of magnetic powders with resins for bonded magnets. The company also leverages its expertise in dispersion, surface modification, and environmental material development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: TODA KOGYO primarily serves manufacturers in the automotive, electronics, ICT, and printing industries. Key end markets include automotive components (especially for EVs), electronic devices (such as MLCCs and inductors), printers and copiers (toner materials), and environmental applications. Major customers include global electronics and automotive parts manufacturers, as well as battery material suppliers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production and sales bases in Japan, China, South Korea, Thailand, Germany, Canada, and the United States. Its sales are well-diversified across Japan, China, other Asian countries, Europe, and North America, with a particularly strong presence in Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: TODA KOGYO is positioned as an upstream to midstream supplier, providing advanced materials and functional components to downstream manufacturers in the electronics, automotive, and battery industries. The company also engages in some downstream activities, such as the production of injection-molded magnets and collaboration with partners for battery materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company is focused on strengthening its business portfolio management, accelerating selection and concentration, and driving growth in magnet materials, dielectric materials, and next-generation soft magnetic and environmental materials. R&D priorities include high-performance magnetic materials for EVs, advanced dielectric materials for miniaturized electronics, CO2 capture and conversion materials, and open innovation through industry-academia-government collaboration. The company is also investing in digital transformation (DX), human capital development, and sustainability initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: TODA KOGYO generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured products (functional pigments, electronic materials, battery materials) to industrial customers. Additional revenue streams include contract manufacturing, licensing of proprietary technologies, and limited service revenue from manufacturing outsourcing and technical support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include global specialty chemical and advanced material companies such as TDK, BASF (via joint ventures), and other Asian and European material suppliers. The company is positioned as a leading fine particle and iron oxide specialist with a strong reputation in magnetic and dielectric materials, but faces intense competition in commoditized segments and from larger, diversified chemical groups.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, consolidated net sales were 31.7 billion yen, up 20.7% year-on-year, but the company posted an operating loss of 648 million yen and a net loss attributable to shareholders of 3.56 billion yen. The company has experienced volatile profitability in recent years, with significant impairment losses and restructuring costs, but maintains a moderate asset base (total assets: 50.7 billion yen) and is targeting a V-shaped recovery through portfolio optimization and growth in strategic segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TODA KOGYO differentiates itself through proprietary fine particle synthesis technologies, high reliability and quality in advanced materials, and the ability to provide customized solutions for demanding applications such as EVs and high-frequency electronics. The company emphasizes its expertise in iron oxide chemistry, global supply capabilities, and commitment to sustainability and open innovation as key sources of customer value.
